items.title: Content depth insufficient for March 2024 Core Update standards
items.description: Recent posts like 'Why Smart Agents Buy Aged Leads Instead of Facebook Ads' and 'Life Insurance Aged Lead ROI' lack the comprehensive depth and first-hand experience details required by the March 2024 Core Update. Google now heavily penalizes thin affiliate content that doesn't provide substantial unique value.
items.recommendation: Expand key posts to 2,500+ words with detailed case studies, specific ROI calculations, screenshots of actual campaigns, and step-by-step implementation guides. Add 'Author's Experience' sections detailing Bill Rice's direct work with these strategies.
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-27

items.title: YMYL expertise demonstration needs strengthening for financial content
items.description: Content covering insurance, mortgage, and financial advisor topics requires stronger E-E-A-T signals as these are Your Money or Your Life topics. Current author bio and credentials are present but not prominently featured within content.
items.recommendation: Add prominent author credential boxes to all YMYL content, include specific years of experience, client success metrics, and industry certifications. Create detailed 'About the Author' sections for each post highlighting relevant expertise for that specific topic.
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-27

items.title: Affiliate disclosure prominence insufficient for 2024 FTC standards
items.description: While affiliate disclosures exist site-wide, they may not meet the FTC's updated 2024 requirements for clear and conspicuous disclosure, especially on mobile devices where disclosures can be less visible.
items.recommendation: Add prominent affiliate disclosure boxes at the top of every post containing affiliate links, use clear language like 'We earn commissions from AgedLeadStore purchases', and ensure mobile visibility with proper styling and positioning.

items.title: Core Web Vitals INP optimization needed for updated thresholds
items.description: With Google's May 2024 update replacing FID with INP and setting new thresholds (good <200ms), affiliate link interactions and content-heavy pages may exceed optimal INP scores, especially on mobile.
items.recommendation: Implement INP monitoring, optimize affiliate link click handlers to be non-blocking, lazy load non-critical content below the fold, and ensure UTM tracking doesn't delay interactions. Use React.startTransition for heavy state updates.

items.title: Missing Product and Review schema reduces rich results eligibility
items.description: Posts reviewing or recommending lead generation services lack Product and Review schema markup, missing opportunities for rich results and reduced visibility in product-related searches.
items.recommendation: Add Product schema for AgedLeadStore with aggregateRating, offers, and detailed descriptions. Implement Review schema for service evaluations with author ratings, pros/cons, and detailed review bodies.
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-27

items.title: Missing images impact user experience and engagement signals
items.description: Two recent posts lack featured images, which impacts user engagement, social sharing, and Google's understanding of content quality and user experience signals.
items.recommendation: Create custom featured images for missing posts, ensure all images have descriptive alt text, and implement next/image optimization. Consider adding infographics and charts to support data-heavy content.
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-27

items.title: Glossary cross-linking underutilized for topical authority
items.description: With 77 glossary terms available, blog posts aren't maximizing internal linking opportunities to build topical authority and help Google understand content relationships and expertise depth.
items.recommendation: Implement automated internal linking to relevant glossary terms within blog content, create topic clusters linking related posts through glossary terms, and add 'Related Terms' sections to blog posts.
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-27

items.title: Content pillar gaps undermine topical authority
items.description: With 0 playbooks and 0 guides, the content strategy is missing comprehensive pillar content that could establish stronger topical authority in lead generation and industry-specific guidance.
items.recommendation: Create 3-5 comprehensive guides (5,000+ words each) covering core topics like 'Complete Guide to Aged Lead Conversion', 'Insurance Agent's Lead Generation Playbook', and industry-specific guides for each vertical.
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-27

items.title: Mobile affiliate link interaction optimization needed
items.description: Affiliate links may not be optimized for mobile touch interactions, potentially impacting user experience and conversion tracking on mobile devices.
items.recommendation: Ensure affiliate links have minimum 44px touch targets, add visual feedback for touches, optimize UTM tracking for mobile, and test affiliate link interactions across devices for smooth user experience.

items.title: Case studies lack verifiable sourcing for credibility

items.recommendation: Add proper disclaimers to all performance claims, cite data sources where possible, anonymize but verify case studies, and include 'results not typical' language where appropriate for compliance.

items.title: FAQ schema opportunities on glossary pages
